summary: FERC's November 10, 2026 Combined Notice of Filings lists many routine electric rate filings. Two PJM entries matter here: the ER26-3515-002 compliance filing on the Large Load definition and registry, and the ER27-454 revised Reliability Backstop Procurement rules.

points.point: FERC notices PJM's compliance filing on the Large Load definition and registry, filed November 9 with comments due November 30, 2026.
points.quote: Compliance filing: Compliance Filing re Large Load Definition and Large Load Registry to be effective 10/12/2026.

points.point: FERC notices PJM's new Section 205 filing revising the backstop procurement rules from ER26-3380, effective January 29, 2027.
points.quote: §205(d) Rate Filing: Revised Reliability Backstop Procurement Rules in ER26-3380-000 to be effective 1/29/2027.

points.point: Interventions and protests are due by 5:00 pm Eastern on each comment date.
points.quote: must file in accordance with Rules 211, 214, or 206 of the Commission’s Regulations (18 CFR 385.211, 385.214, or 385.206) on or before 5:00 pm Eastern time on the specified comment date.

throughLine.text: Sets the comment date of November 30, 2026 for PJM's compliance filing on the Large Load definition and registry in ER26-3515, which supplies the Large Load definition the E-7 study-process directive depends on.
